alignments.note: Waw rendered by the connective *then*, read off the ASV (rule 14); postposed after *How*, so the unit is reordered under rule 25.
Stative verb rendered *can be just*; modal and copula are auxiliaries, head on the complement *just* (rules 17, 44). The subject noun אֱנוֹשׁ is its own unit.
Margin *Or, before* read and set aside; printed *with* governs (rule 38).

*can be clean*, head on the complement *clean*; the *he* belongs to the participial subject, not to this verb, since the ASV writes it as the antecedent of *that is born* (rule 17: an explicit subject takes its own tokens).

Anarthrous passive participle used substantivally; the ASV supplies *he that is* to make it a noun phrase, which joins its unit and heads on *born* (rule 46). Discontinuous under rule 25. Competing reading: *he* as the verb's subject pronoun under rule 17 with only *that is born* here; rejected because the participle is the clause's written subject.
Rectum of the construct participle takes *of* (rule 19); supplied *a* is the noun's (rule 15).
